description:
• About our brand and products: Active Joy Home is a family-first brand on a mission to get kids off screens and back into active play — at home, in the backyard, or anywhere there's room to move. We design playful, durable products that turn everyday moments into fun, active experiences for the whole family. Our best-sellers include the Rainbow Parachute (available in 12ft, 20ft, and 24ft), the Laundry Basketball Hamper (in black and white), and the 4 Hoop Basketball Set (in red and blue). Every product is made to spark imagination, encourage movement, and create memories families actually remember.


• What makes us different: We don't just sell toys — we sell active joy. Our products are loved by parents, teachers, occupational therapists, and party planners because they combine durability with genuine play value. Unlike generic alternatives flooding marketplaces, our products are designed for repeated, intensive use, backed by 5-star reviews, and visually engaging in a way that captures real moments — which is why our customers love sharing their experience on social media. We're a small, founder-led brand that responds quickly, listens to feedback, and treats every partnership as a long-term relationship, not a transaction.

• How affiliates can earn: You'll earn a 10% commission on every sale made through your unique affiliate link or discount code. Your audience gets an exclusive 10% discount when they use your code, making it easy to recommend us authentically. Commissions are tracked in real time through your personal dashboard, and payouts are processed monthly via PayPal. There's no cap on earnings, no minimum sales requirement to stay active, and no hidden fees. Our cookie window is 30 days, so you get credit for purchases even when your audience takes time to decide. 

• How to promote us: Share your unique link and code on the platforms where your audience already lives — Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Pinterest, blog posts, email newsletters, or anywhere else you create content. Our products are highly visual and naturally photogenic, making them perfect for Reels, TikToks, family-day vlogs, gift guides, sensory play features, party setups, and "must-have for boy moms / sports dads / preschool teachers" style content. We encourage authentic storytelling — show how the product fits into your life, not a polished ad. The more real, the better it performs. Tag us at @activejoy_ so we can engage, reshare, and amplify your content.
